source.citation: Saenz-Avalos, M. A. L. (2024), Distribución y posible origen de hidrocarburos en las aguas del Golfo de México durante las campañas oceanográficas XIXIMI IV–VI (2015–2017). MSc thesis, Universidad Autónoma de Baja California, January 2024.
source.access: Retained original institutional MSc thesis. Cover and actual PDF pages 54–55 / printed pages 55–56 visually reviewed. Results prose explicitly names Nautilus II with its own month-resolution formation/dissipation narrative. Figure 6 groups Nautilus/Nautilus II and is not used to infer child size or a physical identity join.

interpretation: The thesis prose explicitly calls the western feature Nautilus II, reports formation in May 2015, describes repeated reconnections to Nautilus, and places dissipation between December 2015 and January 2016. The normalized range is only elapsed calendar support for that author narrative, not a measured continuously tracked lifespan, exact split-to-death interval, or independent verification of the registry child identity.
calculation: Lower bound = 2015-12-01 minus 2015-05-31 = 184 days. Upper bound = 2016-01-31 minus 2015-05-01 = 275 days. Use actual calendar month boundaries; no midpoint, 30-day month, exact May 1 event date or data interpolation.
source_identity_limit: Figure 6 uses combined Nautilus/Nautilus II label; no split date or independently closed child contour is established. This limits physical association, but the separate prose is preserved as its own source-scoped calendar claim.

screened_leads.name: Haskell
screened_leads.decision: Normal original PDF request returned HTTP 403 again. Indexed text repeats existing 200 m thermal-depth reference; no new measurement or source pixels admitted.

screened_leads.name: Lazy
screened_leads.decision: Study concerns an older 1987–1988 Lazy / Eddy E, not the registry Lazy 2000. No transfer of its thermal depths or dimensions.

screened_leads.name: Bosphorus
screened_leads.decision: The approximately 15 km eddies in the cited passage concern Dardanelles inflow into the Marmara Sea, not the named Black Sea Bosphorus recurrent region. No size transfer.

screened_leads.name: Hot Core and Ghostly
screened_leads.decision: January 1986 Hot Core chronology and Ghost Eddy/Fast Eddy split are useful leads, but no independently verified Hot Core/Eddy C or Ghostly/Ghost numeric size crosswalk established. No dimensions or pre-split currents reassigned.
